assign.request: DevTools CSS sidebar flickers on a 1s loop on the generator pages (.page--generator select.page-gen-menu values change and snap back); diagnosed as the Panel clock template repainting on a hidden page; 'do it' = make the clock tick without writing while unseen
steps: diagnose the 1s loop (done live: panel-t-time tick)
headless verify: hidden writes nothing, visible resumes

log.msg: headless proof (Playwright, real flow): /framework/ clock visible = 3 writes/2.5s; routed to /framework/core/Page/generator/ = connected, offsetParent null, 0 writes in 3s, display frozen; routed back = resumes correct time within a tick. Zero page errors.

assign.outcome: **The DevTools flicker is dead: the Panel clock now writes only while seen.** The 1s flicker in Chrome's Styles pane (reported on the [generator pages](/framework/core/Page/generator/), `.page--generator select.page-gen-menu`) was never CSS: [/framework/](/framework/)'s live clock template kept ticking on its hidden SPA page, and every unseen text write made DevTools redraw the pane, sitewide. One guard in `ext/Panel/templates.js` `paint()` - skip the DOM write while `offsetParent` is null, keep the tick so it resumes with the right time within a second. Proven headless in the real flow: visible = 3 writes/2.5s, hidden = 0 writes/3s (still connected), back = resumes on time; zero page errors. Docs: [templates.js file doc](/framework/ext/Panel/doc/templates/) + the decisions.md known-gap entry narrowed (a never-connected clock still re-arms its timer, now silently). Left: the no-op timer itself still runs for the tab's life - one empty timeout/sec, not worth machinery.
